The '''''Courageous''''' was a highly modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]].

==Characteristics==
Despite coming off the assembly lines as a regular YT-1300, the ''Courageous'' underwent several major overhauls from the beginning of its existence. Designed as a vessel of war, most of the cargo space was taken up by additional [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. These generators were necessary for the additional heavy weapons and powerful [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. The rest of the available space was taken over by the massive [[Capacitor/Legends|capacitors]] of the two [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].<ref name="G2" />

The front part of the freighter was completely rebuilt to reinforce the keel and spine. This allowed the ''Courageous'' to carry two forward-firing [[Taim & Bak/Legends|Taim & Bak]] [[XI7 Turbolaser/Legends|XI7 turbolasers]] of a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]]. Additional armament changed with every new owner, but most of them opted for a top-mounted dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turret.<ref name="G2" />

Unlike most other freighters modified as warships, the ''Courageous'' did not carry any [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] or [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launchers]], because too much space was used by the turbolasers.<ref name="G2" />

==History==
The ''Courageous'' came off the assembly lines of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] during the reign of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. It underwent a complete overhaul shortly afterwards and changed owners several times.<ref name="G2" />

The freighter was owned by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], operated by [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] defense forces and a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. As often as it changed owners, the ''Courageous'' was more and more modified and changed configurations.<ref name="G2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Courageous'' was created for the article "[[A Legacy of Starships]]," written by [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] and illustrated by [[Jeffery Carlisle]], published in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine. The ''Courageous'' was representing the [[YT-series/Legends|YT-series]].
